answer: Proof of Stake serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism, requiring agents to bond collateral to participate in consensus. An attacker must acquire a majority stake, which acts like a prism, focusing immense capital costs to distort network truth. This economic barrier ensures that at the dawn of any malicious campaign, the cost of identity proliferation remains tethered to the horizon of financial ruin, effectively rendering the deployment of infinite fake agents prohibitively expensive.
